rows.name: Alabandus

rows.description: a hero of the war of the Seven Against Thebes who became an oracular spirit of the Underworld after his death

rows.name: Ariadne
rows.description: a Cretan princess who became the immortal wife of Dionysus

rows.name: Aristaeus
rows.description: a Thessalian hero, his inventions saw him immortalised as the god of bee-keeping, cheese-making, herding, olive-growing, and hunting

rows.name: Asclepius
rows.description: a Thessalian physician who was struck down by Zeus, to be later recovered by his father Apollo

rows.name: Attis
rows.description: a consort of Cybele, granted immortality as one of her attendants

rows.name: Bolina

rows.name: Endymion

rows.name: Ganymede

rows.name: Glaucus
rows.description: the fisherman's sea god, made immortal after eating a magical herb

rows.name: Hemithea and Parthenos

rows.name: Heracles
rows.description: ascended hero

rows.name: Lampsace
rows.description: a semi-historical Bebrycian princess honored as goddess for her assistance to the Greeks

rows.name: Minos
rows.description: a king of Crete, appointed as a Judge of the Dead in the Underworld after his death

rows.name: Ino
rows.description: a Theban princess who became the sea goddess Leucothea

rows.name: Tenes
rows.description: was a hero of the island of Tenedos

rows.name: The Leucippides
rows.description: wives of the Dioscuri

rows.name: Phoebe
rows.description: wife of Pollux

rows.name: Hilaera
rows.description: wife of Castor

rows.name: Orithyia
rows.description: an Athenian princess abducted by Boreas and made the goddess of cold, gusty mountain winds

rows.name: Palaemon
rows.description: a Theban prince, made into a sea god along with his mother, Ino

rows.name: Phylonoe
rows.description: daughter of Tyndareus and Leda, made immortal by Artemis

rows.name: Psyche
rows.description: goddess of the soul

rows.name: Semele
rows.description: mortal mother of Dionysus, who later was made the goddess Thyone (Θυωνη)
